headline: Lutnick did not take part in Nvidia's decision to reinstate Jensen Huang
summary: US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick did not take part in Nvidia's board decision to reinstate Jensen Huang as chief executive, a source told Reuters on Monday. The report addresses the government's possible role in the decision.
why: The US Commerce Secretary oversees export controls that affect Nvidia's sales of advanced AI chips, so government involvement in the company's leadership matters to investors.
original_headline: Lutnick no participó en la decisión de Nvidia para reinstalar a Jensen Huang
